summary.en: The product mark as a print object: the anchor in process-ink dots, the black plate in 45° dots, the field rings round it in mark space.
summary.zh: 把产品标志当成印刷物：锚点是印刷色网点，黑版是 45° 网点，外圈是标志空间里的场圆环。

fits: Any print-styled film with a mark that has one separable piece.

intent.en: The brand piece is a printed object: process-ink dots on paper, the black plate round it.
intent.zh: 品牌件是一件印刷物：纸上的印刷色网点，四周是黑版。

content.en: The mark as SVG paths in mark units (accent piece, ink plate, box, anchor box).
content.zh: 以标志单位给出的 SVG 路径（强调件、墨版、外框、锚点框）。

fits.zh: 有一块可拆标志件的印刷风格片。

notFor.zh: 照片式标志；带渐变的标志。

en: The anchor always knocks out to paper, also on an ink ground.
zh: 锚点挖白总是挖到纸色，墨底上也一样。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
